case.name: Investment Assistant
case.business_problem: Help customers understand portfolio information and initiate investment workflows safely.
case.desired_outcome: Fast grounded answers with controlled transactional side effects.
case.quality_target: High groundedness and task success on investment queries
case.latency_target: p95 < 2s for read-only requests; p95 < 8s for complex analysis
case.cost_constraint: Up to $800/month at current query volume
case.regulatory_constraints: Suitability, auditability and human/user confirmation before transactional side effects
case.roi_notes: Illustrative assumptions, not measurements: Efficiency: cuts average portfolio-question handling time from ~6 minutes (human) to under 30 seconds. Productivity: frees advisors to focus on complex/high-value cases. Solution cost: estimated at $650/month at current volume, within the $800 budget ceiling.

tradeoff_notes: Routing among a small, known set of tools (balance, portfolio, order) gives the same dynamic tool selection an agent would, with more predictability and auditability for a regulated case; open-ended agent autonomy isn't earned here. Multi-agent adds coordination overhead we don't need yet. Revisit the agent option if intermediate results require the model to control follow-up actions, repetition and termination beyond predefined routes.
